description: Blueprint conformance rule catalog. Maps each button/template/customjs convention to its gate + severity + status + reasoned exemptions. The meta-gate (scripts/lint-conformance-index.js) validates THIS file's structure and enforcing-gate wiring; each gate owns its own detection + exemption logic, which this registry documents (kept in sync by review — the registry is not read back into gate behavior). See Docs/agent-guides/blueprint-conformance.md. Statuses: 'enforcing' = gate wired into release:preflight and green; 'report-only' = gate run by `npm run conformance:audit` (non-blocking), debt still being swept; 'planned' = rule defined, gate not yet built/extended.

rules.title: no-hand-rolled-buttons
rules.notes: Nav/create buttons via manifest blocks; action buttons via AccentButton.render(). 53 hand-rolled sites; output-changing sweep lands as a dedicated PR.

rules.title: icons-via-mechanism
rules.notes: Emoji/raw-svg glyphs in view JS -> Icons.get('kebab-name'). 154 sites; .md prose emoji not flagged. Dedicated PR.

rules.title: note-chrome-adoption

exemptions.reason: kanban-only blueprint; no chromed leaf notes

rules.notes: Mandatory adoption inverts lint-note-chrome.js's current opt-in (manifest breadcrumb block). 8 non-adopters. Per-blueprint note-chrome PR series.

rules.title: template-has-breadcrumb
rules.notes: Enforced over ADOPTED blueprints today (lint-note-chrome.js rule 2). Widens automatically as blueprints adopt via CHR-1.

rules.title: open-mode-routed
rules.notes: New-note open routed through open-helpers/forceLeafPreview. Gate not yet built; lands with the note-chrome PR series.

rules.title: path-variables
rules.notes: No hardcoded ranch/{views,scripts,templates}; use {{views_path}} etc. 229 sites (fixtures/test excluded). Byte-identical for code invocations; per-file-class substitution verification needed for skills/commands/mechanisms. Dedicated sweep PR.

rules.title: no-token-leak
rules.notes: Resolver-aware: a template {{TOKEN}} is a leak only if nothing resolves it (installer vars, now, or a scaffolder .replace). Green. Content/*.md half covered by platform/test/run-content-token-leaks.js.

rules.title: no-content-h2
rules.notes: ## H2 -> SectionLabel. Enforced over ADOPTED blueprints (lint-note-chrome.js rule 1); kanban columns exempt. Widens with CHR-1 adoption.

rules.title: render-nothing
rules.notes: Empty helper output renders NOTHING (project-blueprint-ui.md §3). 22 placeholder strings (finance-heavy). Output-changing; dedicated PR.

rules.title: no-trailing-hr
rules.notes: No dangling final --- in a template body (internal dividers kept). Green (6 fixed).

rules.title: loadable
rules.notes: Bare-class-only, no trailing statements (landmine #31). Pre-existing gate.

rules.title: no-dead-classes
rules.notes: BREAKING (invocation of a class that exists nowhere) is fatal; green. UNDECLARED (manifest-completeness, 9) + DEAD (cleanup candidates, 17) print report-only.

rules.title: contract
rules.notes: Non-static members for customJS.X.method dispatch. Pre-existing gate.
